name: Palette
summary: Draw a colour palette from one hex colour, and tap to explore.
description: Adds a Use permission and a palette app. Launch it from the apps menu or with /palette, type a hex colour, pick a scheme (analogous, complementary, triad, shades), and tap any swatch to make it the new seed. The whole palette is a live scene that looks right in light and dark, and it is computed from the seed alone, so everyone sees the same colours.

changes: Drops a second copy of each response the module kept and never read.
Rebuilt with the reproducible build recipe; works the same.

author: slim-m

permissions.name: Use the palette
permissions.description: Launch and interact with the palette in this space.

extension_points.name: palette
extension_points.description: Draw the palette scene for a seed colour.
